text:
mika: Heads-up — we need to lock the KPI set for the cost dashboard rollout tomorrow. Want the list to reflect routing/quota impacts so PMs don't get surprised.

arjun: proposed minimal KPIs: per-invocation unit cost, per-model marginal cost, cache-savings capture (amortized + real-time), and % requests routed to fallback tier.

lia: also add sampling rate and sampling bias metric (so we can explain any drift in observed unit cost vs true burn). small UI note: put sampling toggle in the rollout preview panel.

product-ops: can we have an SLA-aware projection? PMs expect a "cost at 99th perc latency / steady state" forecast. otherwise they'll think rollout will blow budgets.

arjun: agree. we can compute SLA-aware projected cost by applying route-affinity weights + canary traffic. rough sketch:
```
projected_cost = sum(route_weight * unit_cost_model_variant) * (1 + prefetch_warmup_factor)
```
Need inputs: route_weight, model_variant_delta, cache_warmup curve.

mika: who owns surface for model_variant_delta? that's the thing that often surprises customers when we flip quantization or smaller model for cost savings.

arjun: research/infra will own the model_delta signal (they already emit per-variant latency/cost sample). infra -> telemetry team agreed last week to stitch that into the econ stream.

lia: rollout UX: request a "what-if" slider to simulate different routing policies (sticky vs balanced) and show their cost delta over 24/7, 7-day windows. tiny polymorphism in the panel, not a full-blown simulator.

product-ops: can the dashboard expose a per-tenant "expected monthly delta" so account execs can see downside risk? even rough numbers are helpful.

arjun: yes, with caveat: it's approximate and depends on quota enforcement semantics. We'll surface a confidence band and the sampling rate used.

mika: telemetry checklist for tomorrow's rollout:
- per-request route tag (already in proxy)
- per-variant model_id + quantization flag
- cache-hit boolean + kv-prefetch tag
- sample_rate used for econ aggregation
- canary routing weight

lia: added UX checklist:
- sampling toggle in preview
- what-if slider for routing policy
- small tooltip that explains "amortized cache credits" vs "live cache savings"

sre-bot: deploy: econ-metrics-ingest v2.1 -> staging succeeded (build 8421).

mika: thanks. last call: anyone opposed to shipping without the SLA projection in day-0? PMs prefer we ship with clear "preview" label vs GA.

product-ops: ship preview, but lock the billing-facing disclaimers. I'll draft the messaging: "preview estimates, not guaranteed billing".

arjun: i'll add a debug endpoint to dump the inputs used for projections (for audits). format will be JSON, read-only.

lia: i'll wire the sampling toggle to the preview panel and add the tooltip copy. handing off in ~2h.

mika: awesome — let's meet 30m before rollout. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
